description: Mark episodes of one anime season or film as watched on the signed-in person's MyAnimeTracker list, from episode 1 through the number given. It never unmarks an episode. Episode numbers count within that one entry (season 2 starts again at 1). Give a title or a catalog ID.

mal_id.description: The catalog ID from a title search (the same number MyAnimeList uses). Use it instead of a title when you have it.

through_episode.description: Mark episodes 1 up to this number as watched. Later episodes are left as they are.

title.description: The show's name, in English or romaji, for example "Frieren".

name: mark_episodes_watched
title: Mark episodes watched
